name: persona-watch
description: scripts/app/sim-boot.sh --profile watch, for both simulators of a paired iPhone + Apple Watch (simslim v0.14.0, watchOS 26.5): the default profile plus connectivity (pairing, WatchConnectivity, Continuity), messaging (identityservicesd, which Watch pairing and WCSession transfers go through) and health (HealthKit: the phone_health tools and the watch app). simslim keeps com.apple.homed on watchOS by itself.
